user.title: China Light & Power (CLP) Setup Guide
user.description:
### 📋 How to Obtain CLP Token Credentials:

1. **Log in**: Open Chrome or Edge (Incognito window recommended) and log in to [CLP Online](https://www.clp.com.hk).
2. **Open Console**: Press **F12** (or right-click and select Inspect), then switch to the **Console** tab.
3. **Quick Copy**: Paste and run the following command in the console:
```javascript
console.log("Access Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("act") + "\n\nRefresh Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("rct"));
```
Copy the entire output printed in the console.
4. **Important Notice**:
- Close the browser window directly when done. **DO NOT click "Sign Out"** (signing out will invalidate your tokens).
- Click **"Next"** below and paste the copied text directly into the one-click input box.

tokens.title: Token Authentication
tokens.description: You can paste the entire copied block containing Access Token and Refresh Token into the multiline box below. The separate fields below can be left empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CLP Account
reauth_confirm.description:
Your CLP login credentials have expired. Follow these steps to obtain a new token:

1. Log in to CLP and open Console (F12).
2. Run `console.log("Access Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("act") + "\n\nRefresh Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("rct"));` and copy the output.
3. Close the browser window (do not sign out), then paste into the box below.

options.title: CLP Integration Options
options.description: Configure electricity tariff & price settings, data sync preferences, and optional token updates (leave blank to keep current credentials unchanged).

data.name: Integration/Device Name
data.get_hourly_days: Days of Hourly Data to Fetch (1 or 2)
data.get_estimation: Sync Current Period Usage & Cost Estimation

data_description.name: Custom name for this CLP device and entity prefix. Default: CLP.
data_description.custom_fixed_rate: Default 0. When 0, automatically uses CLP official tiered pricing and estimation; set a positive value (e.g. 1.25) to enforce a flat rate.
data_description.custom_fuel_cents: Default 0. When 0, automatically syncs CLP latest monthly fuel adjustment charge (currently 47.4 cents); set a value to manually lock.
data_description.custom_subsidy: Default 0. Enter government electricity subsidy/rebate amount (HKD) per bi-monthly bill to deduct from projected cost.
data_description.custom_rate_entity: Advanced. Optional entity ID (e.g. input_number.clp_rate) to dynamically control tariff rate. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.custom_tier_rates: Optional. Automatically syncs CLP official tier rates when empty. Or enter comma-separated rates in HKD/kWh for any number of tiers (e.g. 0.945, 1.079, 1.237... or 1.0, 1.5, 2.0; adapts to any tier count).
data_description.custom_tier_limits: Optional. Automatically syncs CLP official bi-monthly tier limits when empty. Or enter comma-separated kWh limits for tiers 1 to N-1 (e.g. 400, 600, 800... or 200, 300); the final tier is automatically unbounded.
data_description.get_hourly: Core data source for HA Energy Dashboard. Ingests hourly consumption and cost statistics for hourly bar charts.
data_description.get_hourly_days: Number of days of hourly data to retrieve (recommend 2 days to ensure uninterrupted continuity).
data_description.get_daily: Retrieves official daily energy totals matching CLP billing day by day.
data_description.get_estimation: Retrieves current billing period consumption, projected units, and projected total bill amount.
data_description.get_bill: Retrieves past 14 months of issued bills and the latest bill total.
data_description.renewable_energy_sensor_enable: Enable if your account participates in CLP's Feed-in Tariff (FiT) scheme (solar PV / wind) to sync renewable energy generation data for the HA Energy Dashboard.
data_description.combined_tokens: Leave empty to keep existing credentials unchanged. If tokens expired, paste full console output here.
data_description.access_token: Leave empty if pasted above. Accepts plain UUID, Bearer, or Base64.
data_description.refresh_token: Leave empty if pasted above. Used to automatically refresh access token upon expiry.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your token values.
error.access_token_invalid: Access token is invalid. Please provide a valid token.
error.access_token_expired: Access token has expired. Please refresh your login and try again.
error.token_format_invalid: Could not parse valid tokens. Ensure the input contains both Access Token and Refresh Token.
error.akamai_blocked: CLP Akamai security temporarily blocked this request. Please try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach CLP API. Please check your network connection.

abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful! Electricity data sync has resumed.
